'use client';

import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Ban, Check, RefreshCw, ScanLine, Trash2, Upload } from 'lucide-react';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import type { Paged, Track } from '@/lib/types';
import { cn, formatBytes, formatDate, formatDuration } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useAuth } from '@/store/auth';

type Tab = 'stats' | 'review' | 'users';

interface Stats {
  tracks: number;
  needsReview: number;
  users: number;
  genres: number;
  withoutCover: number;
  withoutGenre: number;
  libraryBytes: number;
  totalDurationSec: number;
  disk: { freeBytes: number; totalBytes: number } | null;
  topArtists: { artist: string; tracks: number }[];
}

interface ScanState {
  running: boolean;
  total: number;
  processed: number;
  created: number;
  updated: number;
  skipped: number;
  duplicates: number;
  needsReview: number;
  errors: number;
  missing: number;
  pruned: number;
  errorSamples: string[];
  finishedAt: string | null;
}

interface AdminUser {
  id: string;
  username: string;
  email: string;
  role: 'ADMIN' | 'USER';
  canUpload: boolean;
  isBlocked: boolean;
  createdAt: string;
  playlists: number;
  favorites: number;
}

interface Summary {
  needsReview: number;
}

const Err = ({ msg }: { msg: string | null }) => (msg ? <div className="rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-300">{msg}</div> : null);

/* ---------------- РЎС‚Р°С‚РёСЃС‚РёРєР° Рё СЃРєР°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ ---------------- */

function StatsTab() {
  const [stats, setStats] = useState<Stats | null>(null);
  const [scan, setScan] = useState<ScanState | null>(null);
  const [prune, setPrune] = useState(false);
  const [msg, setMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const loadStats = useCallback(() => {
    api<Stats>('/admin/stats').then(setStats).catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadStats();
    api<ScanState>('/admin/scan').then(setScan).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [loadStats]);

  // РїРѕРєР° РёРґС‘С‚ СЃРєР°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ вЂ” РѕРїСЂР°С€РёРІР°РµРј РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСЃ
  const running = scan?.running;
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!running) return;
    const t = setInterval(() => {
      api<ScanState>('/admin/scan')
        .then((s) => {
          setScan(s);
          if (!s.running) loadStats();
        })
        .catch(() => undefined);
    }, 1500);
    return () => clearInterval(t);
  }, [running, loadStats]);

  const startScan = async () => {
    setError(null);
    try {
      setScan(await api<ScanState>('/admin/scan', { method: 'POST', body: { pruneMissing: prune } }));
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    }
  };

  const enrich = async () => {
    try {
      await api('/admin/enrich', { method: 'POST' });
      setMsg('РћР±РѕРіР°С‰РµРЅРёРµ РјРµС‚Р°РґР°РЅРЅС‹С… РїРѕСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ РІ РѕС‡РµСЂРµРґСЊ');
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    }
  };

  const runCleanup = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await api<Record<string, unknown>>('/admin/cleanup', { method: 'POST' });
      setMsg(`Р§РёСЃС‚РєР° Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅР°: ${JSON.stringify(res)}`);
      loadStats();
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    }
  };

  const cards = stats
    ? [
        ['РўСЂРµРєРѕРІ', stats.tracks],
        ['РќСѓР¶РЅР° РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєР°', stats.needsReview],
        ['РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»РµР№', stats.users],
        ['Р–Р°РЅСЂРѕРІ', stats.genres],
        ['Р‘РµР· РѕР±Р»РѕР¶РєРё', stats.withoutCover],
        ['Р‘РµР· Р¶Р°РЅСЂР°', stats.withoutGenre],
        ['Р”Р»РёС‚РµР»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚СЊ', `${Math.round(stats.totalDurationSec / 3600)} С‡`],
      ]
    : [];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <Err msg={error} />
      {stats && (
        <>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 md:grid-cols-4">
            {cards.map(([label, value]) => (
              <div key={label} className="card p-4">
                <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{value}</div>
                <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{label}</div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>

          <div className="card space-y-3 p-4">
            <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
              <span>Р Р°Р·РјРµСЂ Р±РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєРё</span>
              <span className="font-medium">{formatBytes(stats.libraryBytes)}</span>
            </div>
            {stats.disk && (
              <>
                <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded bg-zinc-800">
                  <div
                    className="h-full bg-accent"
                    style={{ width: `${Math.min(100, ((stats.disk.totalBytes - stats.disk.freeBytes) / stats.disk.totalBytes) * 100)}%` }}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500">
                  Р”РёСЃРє: СЃРІРѕР±РѕРґРЅРѕ {formatBytes(stats.disk.freeBytes)} РёР· {formatBytes(stats.disk.totalBytes)}
                </div>
              </>
            )}
            {stats.topArtists.length > 0 && (
              <div className="text-xs text-zinc-400">
                Р‘РѕР»СЊС€Рµ РІСЃРµРіРѕ С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ: {stats.topArtists.map((a) => `${a.artist} (${a.tracks})`).join(', ')}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        </>
      )}

      <div className="card space-y-3 p-4">
        <h3 className="font-semibold">РЎРєР°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ Рё РѕР±СЃР»СѓР¶РёРІР°РЅРёРµ</h3>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
          <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={startScan} disabled={scan?.running}>
            <ScanLine size={16} /> {scan?.running ? 'РЎРєР°РЅРёСЂСѓСЋвЂ¦' : 'Р—Р°РїСѓСЃС‚РёС‚СЊ СЃРєР°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ'}
          </button>
          <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm text-zinc-400">
            <input type="checkbox" checked={prune} onChange={(e) => setPrune(e.target.checked)} /> РЈРґР°Р»СЏС‚СЊ РёР· Р±Р°Р·С‹ РїСЂРѕРїР°РІС€РёРµ С„Р°Р№Р»С‹
          </label>
          <button className="btn" onClick={enrich}>
            <RefreshCw size={16} /> РћР±РѕРіР°С‚РёС‚СЊ РјРµС‚Р°РґР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ
          </button>
          <button className="btn" onClick={runCleanup}>
            <Trash2 size={16} /> РћС‡РёСЃС‚РёС‚СЊ РјСѓСЃРѕСЂ Р‘Р”/РґРёСЃРєР°
          </button>
        </div>
        {msg && <div className="text-sm text-yellow-300">{msg}</div>}
        {scan && (scan.running || scan.finishedAt) && (
          <div className="space-y-2 text-sm text-zinc-300">
            {scan.running && (
              <div className="h-2 overflow-hidden rounded bg-zinc-800">
                <div className="h-full bg-accent transition-all" style={{ width: `${scan.total ? (scan.processed / scan.total) * 100 : 5}%` }} />
              </div>
            )}
            <div>
              РћР±СЂР°Р±РѕС‚Р°РЅРѕ {scan.processed} РёР· {scan.total} В· РЅРѕРІС‹С… {scan.created} В· РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРѕ {scan.updated} В· Р±РµР· РёР·РјРµРЅРµРЅРёР№ {scan.skipped} В· РґСѓР±Р»РёРєР°С‚РѕРІ{' '}
              {scan.duplicates} В· РЅР° РїСЂРѕРІРµСЂРєСѓ {scan.needsReview} В· РѕС€РёР±РѕРє {scan.errors}
              {scan.missing > 0 && ` В· РїСЂРѕРїР°Р»Рѕ СЃ РґРёСЃРєР° ${scan.missing}${scan.pruned ? ` (СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРѕ РёР· Р±Р°Р·С‹: ${scan.pruned})` : ''}`}
            </div>
            {scan.errorSamples.length > 0 && <pre className="overflow-x-auto rounded bg-zinc-900 p-2 text-xs text-red-300">{scan.errorSamples.join('\n')}</pre>}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- РќРµСЂР°СЃРїРѕР·РЅР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ С‚СЂРµРєРё ---------------- */

function ReviewRow({ track, onSaved }: { track: Track; onSaved: (id: string) => void }) {
  const [artist, setArtist] = useState(track.artist === 'Unknown Artist' ? '' : track.artist);
  const [title, setTitle] = useState(track.title);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const save = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api(`/admin/tracks/${track.id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body: { artist: artist.trim(), title: title.trim() } });
      onSaved(track.id);
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const remove = async () => {
    if (!confirm('РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ С‚СЂРµРє РёР· Р±Р°Р·С‹? Р¤Р°Р№Р» РЅР° РґРёСЃРєРµ РѕСЃС‚Р°РЅРµС‚СЃСЏ.')) return;
    await api(`/admin/tracks/${track.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
    onSaved(track.id);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-2 px-4 py-3">
      <div className="truncate text-xs text-zinc-500" title={track.filePath}>
        {track.owner ? `${track.owner} В· ` : ''}{track.filePath?.split(/[\\/]/).pop()} В· {formatDuration(track.duration)} В· {formatBytes(track.fileSize ?? 0)}
      </div>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
        <input className="input !w-auto min-w-0 flex-1" placeholder="РСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЊ" value={artist} onChange={(e) => setArtist(e.target.value)} />
        <input className="input !w-auto min-w-0 flex-[2]" placeholder="РќР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ" value={title} onChange={(e) => setTitle(e.target.value)} />
        <button className="btn btn-primary" onClick={save} disabled={busy || !artist.trim() || !title.trim()}>
          <Check size={16} /> РЎРѕС…СЂР°РЅРёС‚СЊ
        </button>
        <button className="btn" onClick={remove} title="РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ РёР· Р±Р°Р·С‹">
          <Trash2 size={16} />
        </button>
      </div>
      <Err msg={error} />
    </div>
  );
}

function ReviewTab() {
  const [data, setData] = useState<Paged<Track> | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const load = useCallback(() => {
    api<Paged<Track>>('/admin/review', { query: { limit: 100 } }).then(setData).catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, []);
  useEffect(load, [load]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <p className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Р¤Р°Р№Р»С‹, РёРјСЏ РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹С… РЅРµ СЃРѕРѕС‚РІРµС‚СЃС‚РІСѓРµС‚ В«РСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЊ - РќР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµВ» Рё РІ С‚РµРіР°С… РєРѕС‚РѕСЂС‹С… РЅРµС‚ РёСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЏ Рё РЅР°Р·РІР°РЅРёСЏ.</p>
      <Err msg={error} />
      {data && data.items.length === 0 && <div className="card px-6 py-12 text-center text-sm text-zinc-500">РќРµСЂР°СЃРїРѕР·РЅР°РЅРЅС‹С… С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ РЅРµС‚ рџЋ‰</div>}
      {data && data.items.length > 0 && (
        <div className="card divide-y divide-zinc-900">
          {data.items.map((t) => (
            <ReviewRow key={t.id} track={t} onSaved={(id) => setData((d) => d && { ...d, total: d.total - 1, items: d.items.filter((x) => x.id !== id) })} />
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

/* ---------------- РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»Рё ---------------- */

function UsersTab() {
  const me = useAuth((s) => s.user);
  const [users, setUsers] = useState<AdminUser[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = useCallback(() => {
    api<{ items: AdminUser[] }>('/admin/users').then((r) => setUsers(r.items)).catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, []);
  useEffect(load, [load]);

  const patch = async (id: string, body: Partial<Pick<AdminUser, 'isBlocked' | 'canUpload' | 'role'>>) => {
    setError(null);
    try {
      await api(`/admin/users/${id}`, { method: 'PATCH', body });
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    }
  };

  const remove = async (u: AdminUser) => {
    if (!confirm(`РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ ${u.username} РІРјРµСЃС‚Рµ СЃ РµРіРѕ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚Р°РјРё Рё РёР·Р±СЂР°РЅРЅС‹Рј?`)) return;
    try {
      await api(`/admin/users/${u.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      load();
    } catch (e) {
      setError((e as Error).message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <Err msg={error} />
      {users && (
        <div className="card overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm">
            <thead className="text-left text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wide text-zinc-500">
              <tr>
                <th className="px-4 py-2">РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЊ</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2">Р РѕР»СЊ</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2">Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР°</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2">Р РµРіРёСЃС‚СЂР°С†РёСЏ</th>
                <th className="px-4 py-2" />
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y divide-zinc-900">
              {users.map((u) => {
                const self = u.id === me?.id;
                return (
                  <tr key={u.id} className={u.isBlocked ? 'opacity-50' : ''}>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                      <div>{u.username}{self && ' (РІС‹)'}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-zinc-500">{u.email}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                      <select className="input !w-auto !py-1" value={u.role} disabled={self} onChange={(e) => void patch(u.id, { role: e.target.value as 'ADMIN' | 'USER' })}>
                        <option value="USER">User</option>
                        <option value="ADMIN">Admin</option>
                      </select>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-zinc-400">
                        <input type="checkbox" checked={u.canUpload || u.role === 'ADMIN'} disabled={u.role === 'ADMIN'} onChange={(e) => void patch(u.id, { canUpload: e.target.checked })} />
                        <Upload size={14} />
                      </label>
                    </td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2 text-xs text-zinc-400">{formatDate(u.createdAt)}</td>
                    <td className="px-4 py-2">
                      <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                        <button className="btn" disabled={self} onClick={() => void patch(u.id, { isBlocked: !u.isBlocked })}>
                          <Ban size={14} /> {u.isBlocked ? 'Р Р°Р·Р±Р»РѕРєРёСЂРѕРІР°С‚СЊ' : 'Р‘Р»РѕРє'}
                        </button>
                        <button className="btn btn-danger" disabled={self} onClick={() => void remove(u)} aria-label="РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ">
                          <Trash2 size={14} />
                        </button>
                      </div>
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                );
              })}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

export default function AdminPage() {
  const user = useAuth((s) => s.user);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('stats');
  const [summary, setSummary] = useState<Summary | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (user?.role !== 'ADMIN') return;
    api<Summary>('/admin/summary').then(setSummary).catch(() => undefined);
  }, [user?.role, tab]);

  if (user?.role !== 'ADMIN') return <div className="card p-8 text-center text-sm text-zinc-400">Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРї С‚РѕР»СЊРєРѕ РґР»СЏ Р°РґРјРёРЅРёСЃС‚СЂР°С‚РѕСЂР°.</div>;

  const tabs: { id: Tab; label: string; badge?: number }[] = [
    { id: 'stats', label: 'РҐСЂР°РЅРёР»РёС‰Рµ Рё СЃРєР°РЅРёСЂРѕРІР°РЅРёРµ' },
    { id: 'review', label: 'РќРµСЂР°СЃРїРѕР·РЅР°РЅРЅС‹Рµ', badge: summary?.needsReview },
    { id: 'users', label: 'РџРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»Рё' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">РђРґРјРёРЅ-РїР°РЅРµР»СЊ</h1>
      <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1">
        {tabs.map((t) => (
          <button key={t.id} onClick={() => setTab(t.id)} className={cn('flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg px-3 py-1.5 text-sm', tab === t.id ? 'bg-zinc-700 text-white' : 'bg-zinc-900 text-zinc-400 hover:text-white')}>
            {t.label}
            {!!t.badge && <span className="rounded-full bg-accent px-1.5 text-[11px] font-semibold text-black">{t.badge}</span>}
          </button>
        ))}
      </div>
      {tab === 'stats' && <StatsTab />}
      {tab === 'review' && <ReviewTab />}
      {tab === 'users' && <UsersTab />}
    </div>
  );
}

      setData(null);
      setError(null);

    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    const fetchItunesFallback = async (genreTag?: string) => {
      const term = genreTag ? genreTag : 'top songs';
      const res = await fetch(`https://itunes.apple.com/search?term=${encodeURIComponent(term)}&entity=song&limit=50`);
      const raw = await res.json();
      const items: ExternalItem[] = (raw.results || []).map((r: any) => ({
        artist: r.artistName,
        title: r.trackName,
        album: r.collectionName,

    setHint(null);

    } finally {

import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Play } from 'lucide-react';
import { TrackTable } from '@/components/TrackTable';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import type { Paged, Track } from '@/lib/types';
import { trackToItem, usePlayer } from '@/store/player';

export default function FavoritesPage() {
  const [tracks, setTracks] = useState<Track[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    api<Paged<Track>>('/favorites', { query: { limit: 200 } })
      .then((r) => setTracks(r.items))
      .catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  }, []);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">РР·Р±СЂР°РЅРЅРѕРµ</h1>
        <button
          className="btn btn-primary"
          disabled={!tracks?.length}
          onClick={() => tracks && usePlayer.getState().playQueue(tracks.map(trackToItem), 0)}
        >
          <Play size={16} fill="currentColor" /> РРіСЂР°С‚СЊ
        </button>
      </div>
      {error && <div className="rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-300">{error}</div>}
      {tracks && (
        <TrackTable
          tracks={tracks}
          onPlay={(i) => usePlayer.getState().playQueue(tracks.map(trackToItem), i)}
          onDelete={(id) => setTracks((ts) => ts && ts.filter((t) => t.id !== id))}
          // РЎРЅСЏС‚Р°СЏ Р·РІРµР·РґР° РЅРµ СѓРґР°Р»СЏРµС‚ СЃС‚СЂРѕРєСѓ СЃСЂР°Р·Сѓ: РјРѕР¶РЅРѕ РїРµСЂРµРґСѓРјР°С‚СЊ РґРѕ РѕР±РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРёСЏ СЃС‚СЂР°РЅРёС†С‹
          emptyText="РџРѕРєР° РїСѓСЃС‚Рѕ. РќР°Р¶РјРёС‚Рµ в™Ґ Сѓ С‚СЂРµРєР°, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ РґРѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ РµРіРѕ СЃСЋРґР°."
        />

  );

interface ImportTrack {
  artist: string;
  title: string;

interface ImportResult {
  playlist: { id: string; name: string };

interface SpPlaylist {
  id: string;

/* ---------------- Spotify: OAuth Authorization Code + PKCE (РІСЃС‘ РїСЂРѕРёСЃС…РѕРґРёС‚ РІ Р±СЂР°СѓР·РµСЂРµ) ---------------- */

const SCOPES = 'playlist-read-private playlist-read-collaborative';
const TOKEN_KEY = 'loral-sp-token';
const VERIFIER_KEY = 'loral-sp-verifier';
const STATE_KEY = 'loral-sp-state';
const PENDING_KEY = 'loral-pending-import';

const ALPHABET = 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-._~';

function randomString(len = 64): string {
  const bytes = crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(len));
  return Array.from(bytes, (b) => ALPHABET[b % ALPHABET.length]).join('');
}

async function challengeFor(verifier: string): Promise<string> {
  const digest = await crypto.subtle.digest('SHA-256', new TextEncoder().encode(verifier));
  return btoa(String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(digest)))
    .replace(/\+/g, '-')
    .replace(/\//g, '_')
    .replace(/=+$/, '');
}

class SpotifyError extends Error {
  constructor(
    public status: number,
    message: string,
  ) {
    super(message);
  }
}

function loadToken(): string | null {
  try {
    const raw = sessionStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
    if (!raw) return null;
    const { token, exp } = JSON.parse(raw) as { token: string; exp: number };
    return Date.now() < exp ? token : null;
  } catch {
    return null;
  }
}

async function spotify<T>(token: string, urlOrPath: string): Promise<T> {
  const url = urlOrPath.startsWith('http') ? urlOrPath : `https://api.spotify.com/v1${urlOrPath}`;
  const res = await fetch(url, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } });
  if (res.ok) return (await res.json()) as T;
  const body = (await res.json().catch(() => null)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | null;
  throw new SpotifyError(res.status, body?.error?.message ?? `РћС€РёР±РєР° Spotify ${res.status}`);
}

interface Paging<T> {
  items: T[];
  next: string | null;
}

async function fetchAll<T>(token: string, firstUrl: string, limit = 5000): Promise<T[]> {
  const out: T[] = [];
  let next: string | null = firstUrl;
  while (next && out.length < limit) {
    const page: Paging<T> = await spotify<Paging<T>>(token, next);
    out.push(...page.items);
    next = page.next;
  }
  return out;
}

interface RawPlaylist {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  // Spotify РїРµСЂРµРёРјРµРЅРѕРІР°Р» tracks в†’ items (С„РµРІСЂР°Р»СЊ 2026); РїРѕРґРґРµСЂР¶РёРІР°РµРј РѕР±Р° РІР°СЂРёР°РЅС‚Р°
  items?: { total?: number };
  tracks?: { total?: number };
}
interface RawEntry {
  item?: RawTrack | null;
  track?: RawTrack | null;
}
interface RawTrack {
  name?: string;
  type?: string;
  artists?: { name: string }[];
}

async function fetchPlaylistTracks(token: string, id: string): Promise<ImportTrack[]> {
  let entries: RawEntry[];
  try {
    entries = await fetchAll<RawEntry>(token, `/playlists/${id}/items?limit=100&additional_types=track`);
  } catch (e) {
    if (!(e instanceof SpotifyError) || e.status !== 404) throw e;
    entries = await fetchAll<RawEntry>(token, `/playlists/${id}/tracks?limit=100`); // СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕРµ РЅР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ СЌРЅРґРїРѕРёРЅС‚Р°
  }
  const out: ImportTrack[] = [];
  for (const e of entries) {
    const t = e.item ?? e.track;
    if (!t?.name || (t.type && t.type !== 'track')) continue; // РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°РµРј РїРѕРґРєР°СЃС‚С‹ Рё РїСѓСЃС‚С‹Рµ Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё
    const artist = t.artists?.[0]?.name;
    if (artist) out.push({ artist, title: t.name });
  }
  return out;
}

                Redirect URI РІ РЅР°СЃС‚СЂРѕР№РєР°С… РІР°С€РµРіРѕ Spotify-РїСЂРёР»РѕР¶РµРЅРёСЏ РґРѕР»Р¶РµРЅ Р±С‹С‚СЊ: <code className="rounded bg-zinc-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 text-yellow-300">{redirectUri}</code>

                  Р’С‹Р№С‚Рё РёР· Spotify

                      РџРµСЂРµРЅРµСЃС‚Рё

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-white">
              <FileText size={16} className="text-accent" /> РљР°Рє РїРѕР»СѓС‡РёС‚СЊ СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє РёР· Spotify Р±РµР· РІС…РѕРґР°
            </div>
            <ol className="list-decimal space-y-1 pl-5">
              <li>
                РћС‚РєСЂРѕР№С‚Рµ <b>exportify.net</b>, РІРѕР№РґРёС‚Рµ С‡РµСЂРµР· Spotify Рё РЅР°Р¶РјРёС‚Рµ В«ExportВ» Сѓ РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚Р° вЂ” СЃРєР°С‡Р°РµС‚СЃСЏ CSV.

            </ol>
          </div>

          <input className="input" placeholder="РќР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚Р°" value={plName} onChange={(e) => setPlName(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />

            <FileText size={14} /> {fileName || 'Р’С‹Р±СЂР°С‚СЊ С„Р°Р№Р» (.csv, .txt)'}

          </label>
          <textarea
            className="input min-h-40 font-mono text-xs"
            placeholder={'РёР»Рё РІСЃС‚Р°РІСЊС‚Рµ СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє:\nLogic - 44 Bars\nJay-Z - 99 Problems'}

'use client';

import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import {
  Check,
  Heart,
  MoreVertical,
  Pause,
  Play,
  Plus,
  Shuffle,
  Trash2,
  X,
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Cover } from '@/components/Cover';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import type { Track } from '@/lib/types';
import { cn, formatDuration } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useAuth } from '@/store/auth';
import { usePlayer, type NewQueueItem } from '@/store/player';

interface Playlist {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  description?: string | null;
  trackCount?: number;
}

type SortOption = 'recent' | 'title' | 'artist' | 'year';

export default function LibraryPage() {
  const user = useAuth((s) => s.user);
  const canManage = user?.role === 'ADMIN' || Boolean(user?.canUpload);

  const [tracks, setTracks] = useState<Track[]>([]);
  const [playlists, setPlaylists] = useState<Playlist[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);

  // Р¤РёР»СЊС‚СЂС‹ Рё РїРѕРёСЃРє
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [genre, setGenre] = useState<string>('all');
  const [sort, setSort] = useState<SortOption>('recent');

  // РњСѓР»СЊС‚РёРІС‹Р±РѕСЂ
  const [selecting, setSelecting] = useState(false);
  const [selectedIds, setSelectedIds] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());

  // РљРѕРЅС‚РµРєСЃС‚РЅРѕРµ РјРµРЅСЋ РґР»СЏ РѕС‚РґРµР»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ С‚СЂРµРєР°
  const [activeMenuId, setActiveMenuId] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // РњРѕРґР°Р»СЊРЅС‹Рµ РѕРєРЅР°
  const [addToPlaylistTrackIds, setAddToPlaylistTrackIds] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [deleteTrackIds, setDeleteTrackIds] = useState<string[] | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const current = usePlayer((s) => s.queue[s.index]);
  const playing = usePlayer((s) => s.playing);

  const loadData = async () => {
    try {
      const [tRes, pRes] = await Promise.all([
        api<{ items: Track[] }>('/tracks'),
        api<{ items: Playlist[] }>('/playlists').catch(() => ({ items: [] })),
      ]);
      setTracks(tRes.items || []);
      setPlaylists(pRes.items || []);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    void loadData();
  }, []);

  // Р—Р°РєСЂС‹РІР°РµРј РєРѕРЅС‚РµРєСЃС‚РЅРѕРµ РјРµРЅСЋ РїСЂРё РєР»РёРєРµ РІРЅРµ РµРіРѕ
  useEffect(() => {
    const handleClickOutside = (e: MouseEvent) => {
      if (menuRef.current && !menuRef.current.contains(e.target as Node)) {
        setActiveMenuId(null);
      }
    };
    document.addEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('mousedown', handleClickOutside);
  }, []);

  // РЎРїРёСЃРѕРє СѓРЅРёРєР°Р»СЊРЅС‹С… Р¶Р°РЅСЂРѕРІ
  const genres = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    tracks.forEach((t) => t.genres?.forEach((g) => set.add(g.name)));
    return Array.from(set).sort();
  }, [tracks]);

  // Р¤РёР»СЊС‚СЂР°С†РёСЏ Рё СЃРѕСЂС‚РёСЂРѕРІРєР°
  const filtered = useMemo(() => {
    return tracks
      .filter((t) => {
        const q = query.toLowerCase().trim();
        const matchesQuery =
          !q || t.title.toLowerCase().includes(q) || t.artist.toLowerCase().includes(q);
        const matchesGenre =
          genre === 'all' || t.genres?.some((g) => g.name === genre);
        return matchesQuery && matchesGenre;
      })
      .sort((a, b) => {
        if (sort === 'title') return a.title.localeCompare(b.title);
        if (sort === 'artist') return a.artist.localeCompare(b.artist);
        if (sort === 'year') return (b.year ?? 0) - (a.year ?? 0);
        return new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() - new Date(a.createdAt).getTime();
      });
  }, [tracks, query, genre, sort]);

  const toggleSelect = (id: string) => {
    const next = new Set(selectedIds);
    if (next.has(id)) next.delete(id);
    else next.add(id);
    setSelectedIds(next);
  };

  const toggleSelectAll = () => {
    if (selectedIds.size === filtered.length) {
      setSelectedIds(new Set());
    } else {
      setSelectedIds(new Set(filtered.map((t) => t.id)));
    }
  };

  const playTrack = (track: Track) => {
    const player = usePlayer.getState();
    if (current?.kind === 'local' && current.id === track.id) {
      player.toggle();
      return;
    }
    const queueItems: NewQueueItem[] = filtered.map((t) => ({
      kind: 'local',
      id: t.id,
      title: t.title,
      artist: t.artist,
      coverUrl: t.coverUrl,
      duration: t.duration,
    }));
    const index = filtered.findIndex((t) => t.id === track.id);
    player.playQueue(queueItems, index >= 0 ? index : 0);
  };

  const playShuffle = () => {
    if (filtered.length === 0) return;
    const shuffled = [...filtered].sort(() => Math.random() - 0.5);
    const queueItems: NewQueueItem[] = shuffled.map((t) => ({
      kind: 'local',
      id: t.id,
      title: t.title,
      artist: t.artist,
      coverUrl: t.coverUrl,
      duration: t.duration,
    }));
    usePlayer.getState().playQueue(queueItems, 0);
  };

  const toggleFavorite = async (track: Track) => {
    const isFav = track.isFavorite;
    setTracks((prev) =>
      prev.map((t) => (t.id === track.id ? { ...t, isFavorite: !isFav } : t))
    );
    try {
      if (isFav) {
        await api(`/favorites/${track.id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
      } else {
        await api(`/favorites/${track.id}`, { method: 'POST' });
      }
    } catch {
      setTracks((prev) =>
        prev.map((t) => (t.id === track.id ? { ...t, isFavorite: isFav } : t))
      );
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!deleteTrackIds || deleteTrackIds.length === 0) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await Promise.all(
        deleteTrackIds.map((id) => api(`/tracks/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' }))
      );
      setTracks((prev) => prev.filter((t) => !deleteTrackIds.includes(t.id)));
      setSelectedIds((prev) => {
        const next = new Set(prev);
        deleteTrackIds.forEach((id) => next.delete(id));
        return next;
      });
      setDeleteTrackIds(null);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(`РћС€РёР±РєР° РїСЂРё СѓРґР°Р»РµРЅРёРё: ${(e as Error).message}`);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  const handleAddToPlaylist = async (playlistId: string) => {
    if (!addToPlaylistTrackIds || addToPlaylistTrackIds.length === 0) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      await Promise.all(
        addToPlaylistTrackIds.map((trackId) =>
          api(`/playlists/${playlistId}/tracks`, {
            method: 'POST',
            body: { trackId },
          })
        )
      );
      setAddToPlaylistTrackIds(null);
    } catch (e) {
      alert(`РћС€РёР±РєР° РґРѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРёСЏ РІ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚: ${(e as Error).message}`);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5 pb-24">
      {/* РЁР°РїРєР° */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-300 via-rose-300 to-purple-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
            Р‘РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєР°
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-pink-300/60">{tracks.length} С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ</p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => {
              setSelecting(!selecting);
              setSelectedIds(new Set());
            }}
            className={cn(
              'rounded-xl border px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-all cursor-pointer',
              selecting
                ? 'border-pink-400 bg-pink-500/20 text-pink-200'
                : 'border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/40 text-pink-300 hover:text-pink-100'
            )}
          >
            {selecting ? 'РћС‚РјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ РІС‹Р±РѕСЂ' : 'Р’С‹Р±СЂР°С‚СЊ РЅРµСЃРєРѕР»СЊРєРѕ'}
          </button>

          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={playShuffle}
            className="flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-xl bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 via-rose-400 to-purple-400 px-4 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-pink-950 shadow-md hover:opacity-95 cursor-pointer"
          >
            <Shuffle size={14} /> РРіСЂР°С‚СЊ РІРїРµСЂРµРјРµС€РєСѓ
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* РџР°РЅРµР»СЊ РјР°СЃСЃРѕРІС‹С… РґРµР№СЃС‚РІРёР№ */}
      {selecting && selectedIds.size > 0 && (
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/30 bg-pink-950/60 p-3 text-xs backdrop-blur-xl">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={toggleSelectAll}
              className="text-pink-300 hover:text-pink-100 underline cursor-pointer"
            >
              {selectedIds.size === filtered.length ? 'РЎРЅСЏС‚СЊ РІС‹РґРµР»РµРЅРёРµ' : 'Р’С‹Р±СЂР°С‚СЊ РІСЃРµ'}
            </button>
            <span className="text-pink-200 font-semibold">
              Р’С‹Р±СЂР°РЅРѕ: {selectedIds.size}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setAddToPlaylistTrackIds(Array.from(selectedIds))}
              className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl border border-pink-500/30 bg-pink-900/40 px-3 py-1 text-pink-200 hover:bg-pink-800/40 cursor-pointer"
            >
              <Plus size={14} /> Р’ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚
            </button>
            {canManage && (
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setDeleteTrackIds(Array.from(selectedIds))}
                className="flex items-center gap-1 rounded-xl bg-rose-600/80 px-3 py-1 font-semibold text-white hover:bg-rose-500 cursor-pointer"
              >
                <Trash2 size={14} /> РЈРґР°Р»РёС‚СЊ
              </button>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* Р¤РёР»СЊС‚СЂС‹ Рё РїРѕРёСЃРє */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
        <input
          type="text"
          placeholder="РџРѕРёСЃРє РїРѕ РёСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЋ Рё РЅР°Р·РІР°РЅРёСЋ..."
          value={query}
          onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
          className="min-w-[220px] flex-1 rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/40 px-4 py-2 text-xs text-pink-100 placeholder-pink-400/40 outline-none focus:border-pink-400"
        />

        <select
          value={genre}
          onChange={(e) => setGenre(e.target.value)}
          className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-pink-100 outline-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          <option value="all" className="bg-pink-950">
            Р’СЃРµ Р¶Р°РЅСЂС‹
          </option>
          {genres.map((g) => (
            <option key={g} value={g} className="bg-pink-950">
              {g}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>

        <select
          value={sort}
          onChange={(e) => setSort(e.target.value as SortOption)}
          className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/60 px-3 py-2 text-xs font-semibold text-pink-100 outline-none cursor-pointer"
        >
          <option value="recent" className="bg-pink-950">
            РќРµРґР°РІРЅРѕ РґРѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅС‹Рµ
          </option>
          <option value="title" className="bg-pink-950">
            РџРѕ РЅР°Р·РІР°РЅРёСЋ
          </option>
          <option value="artist" className="bg-pink-950">
            РџРѕ РёСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЋ
          </option>
          <option value="year" className="bg-pink-950">
            РџРѕ РіРѕРґСѓ
          </option>
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* РЎРїРёСЃРѕРє С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ */}
      <div className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/15 bg-pink-950/20 backdrop-blur-md overflow-visible divide-y divide-pink-500/10">
        {loading && (
          <div className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-xs text-pink-300/50">
            Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР° РјРµРґРёР°С‚РµРєРё...
          </div>
        )}

        {!loading && filtered.length === 0 && (
          <div className="px-6 py-12 text-center text-xs text-pink-300/50">
            РўСЂРµРєРё РЅРµ РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅС‹
          </div>
        )}

        {!loading &&
          filtered.map((track, i) => {
            const isCurrent = current?.kind === 'local' && current.id === track.id;
            const isSelected = selectedIds.has(track.id);
            const isMenuOpen = activeMenuId === track.id;

            return (
              <div
                key={track.id}
                className={cn(
                  'relative flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-2.5 hover:bg-pink-900/20 transition-colors group',
                  isSelected && 'bg-pink-500/10'
                )}
              >
                {/* Р§РµРєР±РѕРєСЃ РјСѓР»СЊС‚РёРІС‹Р±РѕСЂР° */}
                {selecting ? (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => toggleSelect(track.id)}
                    className={cn(
                      'flex h-5 w-5 shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border transition-colors cursor-pointer',
                      isSelected
                        ? 'border-pink-400 bg-pink-500 text-pink-950'
                        : 'border-pink-500/30 bg-pink-950/40'
                    )}
                  >
                    {isSelected && <Check size={12} strokeWidth={3} />}
                  </button>
                ) : (
                  <span className="w-6 text-right text-xs font-semibold tabular-nums text-pink-400/40">
                    {i + 1}
                  </span>
                )}

                {/* РџРѕСЃС‚РµСЂ / Play */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => playTrack(track)}
                  className="relative shrink-0 cursor-pointer group/cover"
                >
                  <Cover
                    url={track.coverUrl}
                    title={track.title}
                    size={40}
                    className="rounded-xl shadow-md"
                  />
                  <span
                    className={cn(
                      'absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-pink-950/60 transition-opacity',
                      isCurrent ? 'opacity-100' : 'opacity-0 group-hover/cover:opacity-100'
                    )}
                  >
                    {isCurrent && playing ? (
                      <Pause size={16} fill="white" />
                    ) : (
                      <Play size={16} fill="white" />
                    )}
                  </span>
                </button>

                {/* РќР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ Рё РђСЂС‚РёСЃС‚ */}
                <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                  <div
                    className={cn(

            <div className="max-h-60 overflow-y-auto space-y-2 pr-1">
              {playlists.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="text-xs text-pink-300/60 py-4 text-center">
                  РЈ РІР°СЃ РїРѕРєР° РЅРµС‚ СЃРѕР·РґР°РЅРЅС‹С… РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚РѕРІ.

'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Import, Plus } from 'lucide-react';
import { Cover } from '@/components/Cover';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import type { PlaylistSummary } from '@/lib/types';

export default function PlaylistsPage() {
  const [mine, setMine] = useState<PlaylistSummary[] | null>(null);
  const [name, setName] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const load = () => {
    api<{ items: PlaylistSummary[] }>('/playlists')
      .then((r) => setMine(r.items))
      .catch((e: Error) => setError(e.message));
  };
  useEffect(load, []);

  const create = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!name.trim()) return;
    try {
      await api('/playlists', { method: 'POST', body: { name: name.trim() } });
      setName('');
      load();
    } catch (err) {
      setError((err as Error).message);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">РџР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚С‹</h1>
        <Link href="/import" className="btn">
          <Import size={16} /> РРјРїРѕСЂС‚ РёР· Spotify
        </Link>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={create} className="card flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 p-3">
        <input className="input !w-auto min-w-0 flex-1" placeholder="РќР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚Р°" value={name} onChange={(e) => setName(e.target.value)} maxLength={100} />
        <button className="btn btn-primary" disabled={!name.trim()}>
          <Plus size={16} /> РЎРѕР·РґР°С‚СЊ
        </button>
      </form>
      {error && <div className="rounded-lg bg-red-500/10 px-4 py-3 text-sm text-red-300">{error}</div>}

      {mine === null ? (
        <div className="text-sm text-zinc-500">Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР°вЂ¦</div>
      ) : mine.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-sm text-zinc-500">РџРѕРєР° РЅРµС‚ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚РѕРІ.</div>
      ) : (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 md:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-5">
          {mine.map((p) => (
            <Link key={p.id} href={`/playlists/${p.id}`} className="card block p-3 transition-colors hover:bg-zinc-900">
              <Cover url={p.coverUrl} title={p.name} size={160} className="!h-auto aspect-square !w-full" />
              <div className="mt-3 truncate text-sm font-medium">{p.name}</div>
              <div className="truncate text-xs text-zinc-500">{p.trackCount} С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ</div>
            </Link>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

=== МАРШРУТ: E:\Loral\frontend\app\(app)\upload\page.tsx

'use client';

import { useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Loader2, UploadCloud } from 'lucide-react';
import { api, ApiError, uploadFile } from '@/lib/api';
import { NAMING_HINT, validateUploadName } from '@/lib/filename';
import { cn, formatBytes } from '@/lib/utils';
import { useAuth } from '@/store/auth';

interface Row {
  id: number;
  name: string;
  size: number;
  state: 'invalid' | 'queued' | 'uploading' | 'done' | 'error';
  progress: number;
  message?: string;
}

let rowId = 0;

export default function UploadPage() {
  const canUpload = useAuth((s) => s.user?.canUpload);
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<Row[]>([]);
  const [dragging, setDragging] = useState(false);
  const input = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const running = useRef(false);
  const queue = useRef<{ id: number; file: File }[]>([]);
  const playlistIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);

  const patch = (id: number, p: Partial<Row>) =>
    setRows((rs) => rs.map((r) => (r.id === id ? { ...r, ...p } : r)));

  const ensurePlaylist = async () => {
    if (playlistIdRef.current) return playlistIdRef.current;
    const now = new Date();
    const dateStr = `${now.getDate()}.${now.getMonth() + 1}.${now.getFullYear()} ${now.getHours()}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    try {
      const pl = await api<{ id: string }>('/playlists', {
        method: 'POST',
        body: {
          name: `Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР° РѕС‚ ${dateStr}`,
          isPublic: false,
        },
      });
      playlistIdRef.current = pl.id;
      return pl.id;
    } catch {
      return null;
    }
  };

  const pump = async () => {
    if (running.current) return;
    running.current = true;

    // РЎРѕР·РґР°РµРј РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚ РїРµСЂРµРґ СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚РѕРј РїР°С‡РєРё С„Р°Р№Р»РѕРІ
    const playlistId = await ensurePlaylist();

    while (queue.current.length) {
      const { id, file } = queue.current.shift()!;
      patch(id, { state: 'uploading', progress: 0 });
      try {
        const r = await uploadFile(file, (progress) => patch(id, { progress }));
        const createdTrack = (r as { track?: { id: string } }).track;

        if (r.status === 'created' && createdTrack?.id) {
          if (playlistId) {
            await api(`/playlists/${playlistId}/tracks`, {
              method: 'POST',
              body: { trackId: createdTrack.id },
            }).catch(() => null);
          }
          patch(id, { state: 'done', progress: 100, message: 'Р”РѕР±Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ РІ РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚ Рё Р±РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєСѓ' });
        } else if (r.status === 'duplicate') {
          patch(id, { state: 'invalid', message: r.error ?? 'РЈР¶Рµ РµСЃС‚СЊ РІ Р±РёР±Р»РёРѕС‚РµРєРµ' });
        } else {
          patch(id, { state: 'error', message: r.error ?? 'РќРµ СѓРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЊ РґРѕР±Р°РІРёС‚СЊ' });
        }
      } catch (e) {
        patch(id, { state: 'error', message: e instanceof ApiError ? e.message : 'РћС€РёР±РєР° Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєРё' });
      }
    }

    // РЎР±СЂР°СЃС‹РІР°РµРј ID РїР»РµР№Р»РёСЃС‚Р° РґР»СЏ СЃР»РµРґСѓСЋС‰РµР№ СЃРµСЃСЃРёРё Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєРё
    playlistIdRef.current = null;
    running.current = false;
  };

  const addFiles = (list: FileList | File[]) => {
    const fresh: Row[] = [];
    for (const file of Array.from(list)) {
      const id = ++rowId;
      const check = validateUploadName(file.name);
      if (check.ok) {
        fresh.push({ id, name: file.name, size: file.size, state: 'queued', progress: 0 });
        queue.current.push({ id, file });
      } else {
        fresh.push({ id, name: file.name, size: file.size, state: 'invalid', progress: 0, message: check.error });
      }
    }
    setRows((rs) => [...fresh, ...rs]);
    void pump();
  };

  if (!canUpload) {
    return <div className="card p-8 text-center text-sm text-pink-300/70">РЈ РІР°СЃ РЅРµС‚ РїСЂР°РІ РЅР° Р·Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєСѓ С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ. РћР±СЂР°С‚РёС‚РµСЃСЊ Рє Р°РґРјРёРЅРёСЃС‚СЂР°С‚РѕСЂСѓ.</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-5">
      <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-300 via-rose-300 to-purple-300 bg-clip-text text-transparent">
        Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР° С‚СЂРµРєРѕРІ
      </h1>

      <div
        onDragOver={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(true);
        }}
        onDragLeave={() => setDragging(false)}
        onDrop={(e) => {
          e.preventDefault();
          setDragging(false);
          addFiles(e.dataTransfer.files);
        }}
        onClick={() => input.current?.click()}
        className={cn(
          'flex cursor-pointer flex-col items-center gap-2 rounded-2xl border-2 border-dashed px-6 py-14 text-center transition-all duration-300 backdrop-blur-md',
          dragging
            ? 'border-pink-400 bg-pink-500/10 scale-[1.01]'
            : 'border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/20 hover:border-pink-400/50 hover:bg-pink-900/20',
        )}
      >
        <UploadCloud size={40} className="text-pink-400 animate-pulse" />
        <div className="font-semibold text-pink-100">РџРµСЂРµС‚Р°С‰РёС‚Рµ С„Р°Р№Р»С‹ СЃСЋРґР° РёР»Рё РЅР°Р¶РјРёС‚Рµ РґР»СЏ РІС‹Р±РѕСЂР°</div>
        <div className="text-xs text-pink-300/60">
          Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚ РёРјРµРЅРё: <code className="rounded-md bg-pink-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 border border-pink-500/20 text-pink-200">РСЃРїРѕР»РЅРёС‚РµР»СЊ - РќР°Р·РІР°РЅРёРµ.mp3</code>
        </div>
        <input
          ref={input}
          type="file"
          multiple
          accept=".mp3,.flac,.wav,.ogg,.m4a,.opus,audio/*"
          className="hidden"
          onChange={(e) => {
            if (e.target.files) addFiles(e.target.files);
            e.target.value = '';
          }}
        />
      </div>

      {rows.length > 0 && (
        <ul className="rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/15 bg-pink-950/20 backdrop-blur-md divide-y divide-pink-500/10 overflow-hidden">
          {rows.map((r) => (
            <li key={r.id} className="flex items-center gap-3 px-4 py-3">
              {r.state === 'done' && <CheckCircle2 size={18} className="shrink-0 text-pink-400" />}
              {(r.state === 'invalid' || r.state === 'error') && <AlertCircle size={18} className="shrink-0 text-rose-400" />}
              {r.state === 'uploading' && <Loader2 size={18} className="shrink-0 animate-spin text-pink-300" />}
              {r.state === 'queued' && <Loader2 size={18} className="shrink-0 text-pink-500/40" />}
              <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
                <div className="truncate text-sm font-medium text-pink-100">{r.name}</div>
                <div className={cn('text-xs', r.state === 'invalid' || r.state === 'error' ? 'text-rose-300' : 'text-pink-300/60')}>
                  {r.state === 'uploading'
                    ? `Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР°вЂ¦ ${r.progress}%`
                    : r.state === 'queued'
                      ? `Р’ РѕС‡РµСЂРµРґРё В· ${formatBytes(r.size)}`
                      : (r.message ?? '')}
                </div>
                {r.state === 'uploading' && (
                  <div className="mt-1.5 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-pink-950">
                    <div className="h-full bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 to-rose-400 transition-all duration-200" style={{ width: `${r.progress}%` }} />
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      )}
      <p className="text-xs text-pink-400/40">{NAMING_HINT}</p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { GlobalPlayer } from '@/components/GlobalPlayer';
import { Sidebar } from '@/components/Sidebar';
import { api } from '@/lib/api';
import type { User } from '@/lib/types';
import { useAuth, useAuthHydrated } from '@/store/auth';

/**
 * Р­С‚РѕС‚ layout РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚РёСЂСѓРµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё РЅР°РІРёРіР°С†РёРё РјРµР¶РґСѓ СЃС‚СЂР°РЅРёС†Р°РјРё РіСЂСѓРїРїС‹ (app),
 * РїРѕСЌС‚РѕРјСѓ <GlobalPlayer/> СЃ РµРґРёРЅСЃС‚РІРµРЅРЅС‹Рј <audio> Р¶РёРІС‘С‚ РЅРµРїСЂРµСЂС‹РІРЅРѕ вЂ” РјСѓР·С‹РєР° РЅРµ РїСЂРµСЂС‹РІР°РµС‚СЃСЏ.
 */
export default function AppLayout({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const hydrated = useAuthHydrated();
  const user = useAuth((s) => s.user);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (hydrated && !user) {
      // Spotify РІРµСЂРЅСѓР» РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ РЅР° /import РґРѕ РІС…РѕРґР° вЂ” Р·Р°РїРѕРјРёРЅР°РµРј РєРѕРґ Р°РІС‚РѕСЂРёР·Р°С†РёРё
      if (location.pathname === '/import' && location.search.includes('code=')) {
        sessionStorage.setItem('loral-pending-import', location.search);
      }
      router.replace('/login');
    }
  }, [hydrated, user, router]);

  // РђРєС‚СѓР°Р»РёР·РёСЂСѓРµРј СЂРѕР»СЊ/РїСЂР°РІР° (РёС… РјРѕРі РёР·РјРµРЅРёС‚СЊ Р°РґРјРёРЅ)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!user) return;
    api<{ user: User }>('/auth/me')
      .then((r) => useAuth.getState().setUser(r.user))
      .catch(() => undefined);
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [user?.id]);

  if (!hydrated || !user) {
    return <div className="flex h-screen items-center justify-center text-sm text-zinc-500">Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР°вЂ¦</div>;
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex h-screen flex-col md:flex-row">
      <Sidebar />
      <main className="min-h-0 flex-1 overflow-y-auto pb-[104px]">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl p-4 md:p-8">{children}</div>
      </main>
      <GlobalPlayer />
    </div>
  );
}

import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export default function AppPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  useEffect(() => {
    router.replace('/library');
  }, [router]);

  return (
    <div className="flex h-[80vh] w-full flex-col items-center justify-center gap-3">
      <Loader2 size={36} className="animate-spin text-pink-400" />
      <p className="text-sm font-medium text-pink-200/70">Р—Р°РіСЂСѓР·РєР° РљРёРјРёвЂ¦</p>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Lock, Mail, User, Loader2, Music2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { Logo } from '@/components/Logo';
import { api, ApiError } from '@/lib/api';
import { useAuth } from '@/store/auth';

export default function LoginPage() {
  const router = useRouter();

  const [mode, setMode] = useState<'login' | 'register'>('login');
  const [username, setUsername] = useState('');
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const submit = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setError(null);
    setLoading(true);

    try {
      const endpoint = mode === 'login' ? '/auth/login' : '/auth/register';
      
      // РџРµСЂРµРґР°РµРј Рё username, Рё login РѕРґРЅРѕРІСЂРµРјРµРЅРЅРѕ, С‡С‚РѕР±С‹ Р±СЌРєРµРЅРґ С‚РѕС‡РЅРѕ РЅР°С€РµР» РЅСѓР¶РЅРѕРµ РїРѕР»Рµ
      const body: any = {
        username,
        login: username,
        password,
      };

      if (mode === 'register' && email) {
        body.email = email;
      }

      const res = await api<{ accessToken: string; refreshToken: string; user: any }>(endpoint, {
        method: 'POST',
        body,
        anonymous: true,
      });

      const store = useAuth.getState();
      if (typeof (store as any).setAuth === 'function') {
        (store as any).setAuth(res.user, res.accessToken, res.refreshToken);
      } else if (typeof (store as any).login === 'function') {
        (store as any).login(res.user, res.accessToken, res.refreshToken);
      } else {
        useAuth.setState({
          user: res.user,
          accessToken: res.accessToken,
          refreshToken: res.refreshToken,
        });
      }

      router.replace('/library');
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof ApiError ? err.message : 'РџСЂРѕРёР·РѕС€Р»Р° РѕС€РёР±РєР° СЃРѕРµРґРёРЅРµРЅРёСЏ');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen w-full items-center justify-center p-4">
      <form onSubmit={submit} className="w-full max-w-sm space-y-5 rounded-3xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/40 p-8 shadow-2xl shadow-pink-950/80 backdrop-blur-xl">
        
        {/* Р›РѕРіРѕС‚РёРї */}
        <div className="flex justify-center pb-2">
          <Logo />
        </div>

        {/* РџРµСЂРµРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚РµР»СЊ Р’С…РѕРґ / Р РµРіРёСЃС‚СЂР°С†РёСЏ */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1 rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/15 bg-pink-950/50 p-1 text-sm">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setMode('login'); setError(null); }}
            className={`rounded-xl py-2 font-medium transition-all ${
              mode === 'login'
                ? 'bg-pink-500/30 border border-pink-400/40 text-pink-100 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-pink-300/60 hover:text-pink-200'
            }`}
          >
            Р’С…РѕРґ
          </button>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => { setMode('register'); setError(null); }}
            className={`rounded-xl py-2 font-medium transition-all ${
              mode === 'register'
                ? 'bg-pink-500/30 border border-pink-400/40 text-pink-100 shadow-sm'
                : 'text-pink-300/60 hover:text-pink-200'
            }`}
          >
            Р РµРіРёСЃС‚СЂР°С†РёСЏ
          </button>
        </div>

        {error && (
          <div className="rounded-2xl border border-rose-500/30 bg-rose-500/10 p-3 text-center text-xs font-medium text-rose-200">
            {error}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-3">
          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-pink-300/85">РРјСЏ РїРѕР»СЊР·РѕРІР°С‚РµР»СЏ / Р›РѕРіРёРЅ</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <User size={16} className="absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-pink-400/50" />
              <input
                type="text"
                required
                value={username}
                onChange={(e) => setUsername(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Р’РІРµРґРёС‚Рµ Р»РѕРіРёРЅ"
                className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/60 py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-pink-100 placeholder-pink-300/30 outline-none transition-all focus:border-pink-400 focus:bg-pink-900/40 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500/20"
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* РџРѕР»Рµ Email РїРѕСЏРІР»СЏРµС‚СЃСЏ РїСЂРё СЂРµРіРёСЃС‚СЂР°С†РёРё */}
          {mode === 'register' && (
            <div>
              <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-pink-300/85">Email</label>
              <div className="relative">
                <Mail size={16} className="absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-pink-400/50" />
                <input
                  type="email"
                  required
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(e) => setEmail(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="name@example.com"
                  className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/60 py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-pink-100 placeholder-pink-300/30 outline-none transition-all focus:border-pink-400 focus:bg-pink-900/40 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500/20"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <div>
            <label className="mb-1 block text-xs font-semibold text-pink-300/85">РџР°СЂРѕР»СЊ</label>
            <div className="relative">
              <Lock size={16} className="absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-pink-400/50" />
              <input
                type="password"
                required
                value={password}
                onChange={(e) => setPassword(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="вЂўвЂўвЂўвЂўвЂўвЂўвЂўвЂў"
                className="w-full rounded-2xl border border-pink-500/20 bg-pink-950/60 py-3 pl-10 pr-4 text-sm text-pink-100 placeholder-pink-300/30 outline-none transition-all focus:border-pink-400 focus:bg-pink-900/40 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-pink-500/20"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <button
          type="submit"
          disabled={loading}
          className="flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-2xl bg-gradient-to-r from-pink-500 via-rose-400 to-purple-400 py-3.5 text-sm font-bold text-pink-950 shadow-lg shadow-pink-500/25 transition-all hover:opacity-95 active:scale-[0.99] disabled:opacity-50"
        >
          {loading ? (
            <Loader2 size={18} className="animate-spin" />
          ) : (
            <Music2 size={18} />
          )}
          {mode === 'login' ? 'Р’РѕР№С‚Рё РІ РљРёРјРё' : 'РЎРѕР·РґР°С‚СЊ Р°РєРєР°СѓРЅС‚'}
        </button>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}
